newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine c. bank sells dollars at 28.50 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine c. bank sells dollars at 28.50 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine central bank sold dollars at 28.50 pesos early on Monday, traders said.
The central bank sold about $6 million at $1 million per transaction, they estimated.
Traders said the central bank had promised to sell more dollars in a meeting early on Monday with chief executive officers of banks.
Banks are currently hard pressed to meet the dollar requirements of importers.
"There's pressure on the peso because of import requirements," a bank trader said.
After more than 30 minutes of trading, the peso traded from 28.47/28.50 to the dollar. Volume was light at $12.5 million.
The peso ended at 28.47 on Friday.
